Jakub Novak  
📞 +91 987-654-3210 | 📧 jnovak@ecocarttech.com | 📍 Bengaluru, India | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/jakubnovak  

Professional Experience  
From 2018 to 2020, I contributed to the development of scalable e-commerce features at GreenLeaf Startups, where I leveraged Python/Django for backend logic and React for dynamic frontend components. My work focused on optimizing database queries for inventory management systems, which reduced query latency by 40% and improved inventory tracking accuracy. Transitioning to Varta Commerce in 2020, I took on the role of Lead Full-Stack Developer, architected microservices for real-time pricing updates, and mentored three junior engineers. This involved designing REST APIs with PostgreSQL for data consistency, integrating Node.js for server-side rendering, and establishing CI/CD pipelines for frontend components using GitHub Actions. Since 2022, I have led the architecture for EcoCart Technologies’ headless commerce platform, where I integrated GraphQL APIs with MongoDB and Redis, while managing cloud infrastructure on AWS. My responsibilities include designing load-balanced architectures for high-traffic scenarios, ensuring fault tolerance through Kubernetes deployments, and implementing monitoring solutions with Prometheus and Grafana.  

Technical Skills  
Throughout my career, I have developed a deep understanding of full-stack technologies, with significant contributions to production systems. At EcoCart, I oversee the deployment of AWS services, including EC2 instances and S3 buckets, to support the headless commerce platform. My work with Kubernetes involves managing containerized applications, ensuring scalability and reliability. I have implemented load balancing strategies using Nginx and AWS ELB, which improved system responsiveness during peak traffic. In previous roles, I optimized Python applications for performance, particularly in backend services that handled real-time pricing updates. I have also built critical components in Go for high-throughput systems, such as asynchronous message queues. My experience with Node.js and React has enabled the creation of responsive, single-page applications, while my use of TypeScript has enhanced code maintainability in large-scale projects. REST API design is a cornerstone of my work, with examples including the development of secure, scalable endpoints for inventory management and user authentication.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Technical University of Prague, 2018.  

Projects  
At EcoCart Technologies, I spearheaded the development of a headless commerce platform, integrating GraphQL APIs with MongoDB for flexible data querying and Redis for caching. This project required designing a microservices architecture that supported real-time updates and ensured low-latency responses. A previous project at Varta Commerce involved building a real-time pricing engine using Go and Node.js, which reduced pricing discrepancies by 30% through automated data synchronization. At GreenLeaf Startups, I developed an inventory management system using Python and PostgreSQL, where I optimized database queries and implemented caching strategies to improve performance.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Czech (native), Hindi (basic).  

Volunteer / Open Source  
I actively contribute to open-source projects on GitHub, particularly in the realm of e-commerce and cloud infrastructure. My work includes maintaining a repository for a lightweight Node.js middleware that streamlines API authentication and collaborating on a TypeScript-based framework for headless commerce. I also mentor junior developers through coding workshops and participate in hackathons focused on sustainable technology solutions.
